Corrosion +66: Passive: +66 Equipment bonus to Acid Spell Power.
Impulse +66: Passive: +66 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Potency +44: Passive: +44 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
